resources.string: Enhanced features
Optional extras: link detection, bubble, cleaner and downloads
Enhanced Features
These extras are optional. Linksi works exactly as before with all of them switched off, and none of them is required for saving, sharing or organising links.
Smart Link Detection
Notice when you copy a link
Floating Linksi Bubble
Show a small bubble when a link is detected
Accessibility assistance
Improve detection of link copy actions

Linksi can optionally use Android Accessibility services to detect likely link-related actions and show its quick action bubble. This feature is optional. Standard sharing and saving work without it. Linksi never reads password fields, never stores screen contents and never sends accessibility data anywhere.
Download notifications
Show progress and completion notifications for downloads
Private server fallback
Ask your own server to resolve a link when the device cannot
Server address
https://example.com
Access token (optional)

When local extraction fails, the link\'s URL is sent to the server you configure so it can return the media information. Nothing else is sent: no clipboard contents, no screen contents and no saved links. Linksi keeps working if the server is offline.
The server address must use HTTPS.
